problem_text:
A logistics company needs to distribute a total shipment volume across 10 regional distribution centers to maximize total expected delivery efficiency. The performance metrics for each center are as follows:
* Center 1: expected delivery efficiency is 0.166, operational complexity is 0.195, capacity bounds [0.061, 0.530]
* Center 2: expected delivery efficiency is 0.031, operational complexity is 0.183, capacity bounds [0.008, 0.411]
* Center 3: expected delivery efficiency is 0.038, operational complexity is 0.187, capacity bounds [0.013, 0.681]
* Center 4: expected delivery efficiency is 0.177, operational complexity is 0.180, capacity bounds [0.012, 0.716]
* Center 5: expected delivery efficiency is 0.054, operational complexity is 0.111, capacity bounds [0.031, 0.687]
* Center 6: expected delivery efficiency is 0.079, operational complexity is 0.255, capacity bounds [0.018, 0.900]
* Center 7: expected delivery efficiency is 0.102, operational complexity is 0.189, capacity bounds [0.069, 0.633]
* Center 8: expected delivery efficiency is 0.067, operational complexity is 0.246, capacity bounds [0.051, 0.594]
* Center 9: expected delivery efficiency is 0.175, operational complexity is 0.215, capacity bounds [0.042, 0.384]
* Center 10: expected delivery efficiency is 0.115, operational complexity is 0.096, capacity bounds [0.014, 0.489]

Each center must receive a proportion of the total shipment volume that falls within its specified capacity bounds, and all proportions must sum to one. To maintain adequate operational flexibility, the company requires that centers with advanced processing capabilities, represented by the subset P = {1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10}, collectively handle at least 0.317 of the total volume. Additionally, the overall system complexity, measured by a composite complexity index, must not exceed 0.247, and the total expected delivery efficiency must be at least 0.074. Determine the optimal volume allocation that maximizes total expected delivery efficiency while satisfying all constraints.
